title: kate-ui: sound paint recovery, resume color, buffer the fixture
summary: Sound paint recovery for the GPUI spike. A panic inside entity update no longer drops the window root. Coloring resumes at a plain cache miss. The fixture writer is buffered. The editor font loads before the first timed paint. Steady-state paint and idle recolor stay on the same path.

lane.reason: The change is Rust in kate-ui. This VM cannot link GPUI. The macos-15 job builds the crate and runs the tests.

definitions.definition: fn resume_color_line(color_at: u32, visible_first: u32, visible_last: u32, plain_line: u32) -> u32

fn paint_with_loan<R>(root: &mut WindowRoot, paint: impl FnOnce(&mut ShapedLineCache, &mut KeyedCache<ShapedLine>, &mut WindowRoot) -> R) -> Result<R, Box<dyn std::any::Any + Send>>

fn warm_editor_font(window: &mut Window)

fn request_color_frame(window: &Window);
fn write_buffered(out: impl Write, count: u32) -> io::Result<()>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: No public signature change. Paint catches a panic inside the entity update. Color resume takes the first plain line. The fixture file writer is a BufWriter.

regression_tests.name: highlight::tests::resume_color_line_keeps_the_cursor_when_the_plain_line_is_later
regression_tests.asserts: A plain line at or after the color cursor does not move the cursor back to the first visible line.

regression_tests.name: fixture::tests::fixture_writer_buffers_many_small_line_writes
regression_tests.asserts: Two thousand fixture lines produce fewer write calls than lines, and the bytes match the unbuffered generator.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::panic_inside_model_update_keeps_the_window_root_and_the_caches
regression_tests.asserts: A panic inside the model update during paint still propagates, and the window root plus its shape cache remain usable.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::apply_frame_requests_an_animation_frame_while_coloring_is_pending
regression_tests.asserts: apply_frame calls request_animation_frame on a partial color pass and does not call it on a plain paint.

regression_tests.name: session::tests::plain_tail_does_not_restart_coloring_at_the_first_line
regression_tests.asserts: After a plain cache miss in the tail, the next color pass replans from the color cursor, not from line 0.
